reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: FK Bodø/Glimt are favoured at 59%, against 20% for Lille OSC and 21% for the draw. FK Bodø/Glimt carry 65 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: FK Bodø/Glimt 1.8 points per game, Lille OSC 0.2. They average 2.0 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.70 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 71%. Across their last five, FK Bodø/Glimt and Lille OSC have scored 1.5 and conceded 2.3 a game between them.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.
